Step 1: Draw a line segment \(BC = 4 \, \text{cm}\).

Step 3: On ray BF, cut a segment \(BD = 7 \, \text{cm}\).
Step 4: Join points C and D.

Step 1: Perimeter of triangle = \(4 + 7 = 11 \, \text{cm}\). Side of rhombus = \(11 / 4 = 2.75 \, \text{cm}\).
Step 2: Draw line segment \(AB = 2.75 \, \text{cm}\).
